talas.t: Still awake. Shift tomorrow 9, the bank system froze twice today
Up before the kettle again. Frost on the potato rows, -6 on the thermometer
Cash count done, no mistakes. Going to the bazar in 30 min, anyone need dollars changed?
Wait for the 1pm rate, the morning one is bad. Hay is going up in the valleys, 26 a bale now
Saturday, mask on, bus to the hippodrome later 🐎
Morning! Air in Talas says moderate today, Nurzhan is much worse. Who is going to the match tonight?
Kids want to come to the Hippodrome at 7 but it is cold. Thermos and blankets, we'll see
Wait, which match? Ulak or the ISEZ thing?
ISEZ round 11, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00, State Hippodrome. Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak right after at 21:00
We need the win. Chu is on 26, we are on 22. Kyzyl-Adyr are on 13 so should be easy
Nothing is easy with ulak. Last time Kyzyl-Adyr took a horse off our side 😤
Shoes on the horse, not the man 🤣
Morning. Got my first customer at the counter already, a Samsung with a cracked screen and a very loud child
Kayırluu tañ. Attelkom internet is back to normal this morning, finally
Good, it was crawling for me too last week
Is the 14 bus running today? Nobody on my street knows
Yes, it came at 8:10 for me. Full of people going to the bazar
Rahmat! Taking it to the Tündük then
Potatoes are 2.10 a kilo at the bazar now. Not cheap but not bad for November
Last year it was 2.40 by this time. Better buy a sack
Sack is 1.80 if you take 50kg, I already said. Stop asking 😂
Changers rate this morning: USD 11.55 buy, 11.95 sell. Don't go to the back rows, they cheat on the small notes
Official rate is still 8.40 and nobody believes it lol
Official rate is for the bank, not for us 😅
[sticker: horse_love]
Anyone know a shop that sells proper winter tyres for a Lada? Asking for a friend who is also me
Come to the tyre shop on the Trans-Talas road. Not the one by the fuel station, the other one 😄
Ok the other one. Rahmat
Going to the Tündük for plov, 28 a plate, they have a corner table for us
Plov 28 still? Ok I'll bring the kids Sunday
Thursday exchange is on 26th. Who is coming? Rustam you still owe us boorsok
I'll bring it, promise. Bought a bag of walnuts from Toktogul instead, 22 a kilo, sold out in my flat
Walnuts from Toktogul in Talas? Traveling salesman 😂
The Talasbank branch queue on Monday is going to be insane, salary day. Pray for me
Heard the Toktogul reservoir is at 82.4% and dropping. Hope the winter is kind to the power lines
Power is fine here. Coal came yesterday, 4 tonnes. Paid already, no discount
Our radiators are warm all day now. Tell me this is not a dream ☺️
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Anyone else reading about the Rim pilgrims stuck in Tashkent? A week already. Poor people
Saw that. No consul to call either, that's the worst part
My aunt was going on that pilgrimage next spring. Now she's worried
Let's pray for them 🙏
Did anyone see the Talas Herald piece on the hydrology grant? 30% cut to $420,000. Gauges stay though
Good that the gauges stay. Cutting the money and keeping the stations is a very Irad idea
Stations without people to read them are just pretty poles 😅
[poll: Going to the ISEZ match tonight at the Hippodrome?]
Yes, my horses are going to sit on the fence and judge
No, tonight I sleep. Potatoes at 5 tomorrow again
Thermos and kids, yes 🍵
Air in Nurzhan is 160 today, Talas only 90. Keep the windows shut in Nurzhan people
I'm in Talas and I still smell the refinery when I walk past the bus station. Weird
That's the wind. It comes from Nurzhan on the bad days
Going to the Hippodrome by 18:30. Who's sitting near the east stand?
We'll be near the gate, the one with the broken lamp
Found you, the thermos is already out 🍵
Kids are singing at the Hippodrome already. Talas is loud tonight 😄
Match started! Talas on the attack already
Dangerous ball, dangerous ball 🔥
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Ask me after the final whistle, my voice is gone 😅
Horses are quiet now, they did not like the shouting
Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak starting now, we're staying for it. Cold though
Anyone watching Sunday's Tulpar women's game? Women's League is almost done, Tulpar 23 on top
Tulpar women are the real champions this year, nobody argue
Kids asleep in the car on the way home. Good night from the stands 🌙
Sorry, late. Repair shop closed, flat hunting tomorrow. Anyone seen a flat near the Tündük under 1,500?
Same agent by the Tündük. Tell him Begaiym sent you, he's still honest-ish
Honest-ish again 😂 rahmat
Night all. Mask tomorrow if you go to the bazar 😷
Night, dress warm 🧣
[sticker: salam]
Night Talas. Cash count at 6, dreaming of dollars again 💵
Night. Shift at 9 tomorrow, don't wake me 🌙
Awake already? Cash count done, now coffee 😴
Frost on the potato rows this morning. Lost nothing, thank God
Kayırlı tañ everyone 🍵 Kids want pancakes, I say no pancakes before school
Kayırlı tañ. Stop them making you cave
Kayırlı tañ! Sunday, no school for me, just marking 40 essays 😩
Morning. Going to check the flat near Tündük at 10. Wish me luck
Ask for the one with the south window, the north ones are dark all winter
Noted. Rahmat 🙏
Sunday at the Hippodrome. Horses don't care what day it is, they want their hay
Hay in the valleys is 26 som a bale now. My cousin says it was 20 in the summer, robbery
Summer hay was cut in June, that's why. Winter is always dearer, you'll see
Ok old man 😂
Morning. Anyone going to the Hippodrome for the Tulpar women's thing? Or just the Sunday horses
Women's League is done, Tulpar finished top. Nothing left to play 🏆
Right, I keep forgetting. Still, a good season
Salam. Anyone know if the bazar is open for the Sunday rows or only Saturday?
Open, the inner rows are busy until noon. Changers at the front, rates on the board
Nurbek, is your aunt's stall reopened yet?
Not yet. She sells from her kitchen, phone orders. Thanks for asking 🙏
Tell her good luck from my class, the kids made her a card
Air check before I open the window: Talas 100, moderate. Mask only if you have asthma
Still smells of the refinery at the bus station 😅
Wind is from the west today, should clear it. Nurzhan is still bad, 234 on the site
Nurzhan 234, very unhealthy. My sister there says the kids can't go out at break
Heat plant still on the old gas. They keep promising. Nobody pays for the switch
[sticker: kosh]
Who is taking the 14 to Semiz today? Aizada you still on it?
Yes, but I'm walking to Tündük first. Bus is slow on Sundays
Trans-Talas lane still closed near the North Terminal btw. Went round by the old road
Old road is fine in the day. Watch the potholes
Taxi from the centre to Kyzyl-Adyr marshrutka side is 30 som. Anyone else seen that?
The marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr is 30, yes. Taxi in town from 15 som, don't let them charge more
Back from the flat viewing. 1,400 for a one-room near Tündük, north side. Too dark for me
Told you! Take the south one or walk away 😂
Ok I walk away. Rahmat Begaiym
Sunday teller shift just ended, my feet are dead
[sticker: haha]
Reminder, Thursday exchange is 18:30 at the Tündük café this week, not the old place. Boorsok on me 🥟
Coming Thursday! Will bring the boorsok rule up 😅
Is the Tündük café open on Sundays?
Yes until 22:00. Chai is good
Lunch done, the kids are now building a snowman on the one white patch in the yard ⛄
First snow of the year on the Old City roofs? Looks like the mountains got it
Mountains yes, we just had frost. Snowman is the size of a loaf of nan 😂
Went to the Hippodrome stables. Both horses fine, hay is in. Plenty of straw
Good. Keep the stable warm, ventilate at midday only
Yes doctor 🐴
Changers this morning: USD 11.50 buy, 12.00 sell. Euro 12.50 / 13.10. Euros are moving today
Official is 8.40, changers are a long way off. Don't be the one who buys at the front
Ha, I'm the one who sells 😂 Buy at the back, count your notes
Anyone following the Tulparcoin price? Someone at work said it's up
Tulparcoin isn't money, don't buy it in Talas. Quote says 3.40 cents, +3.5% today, that's all
Ok ok, just asking 🙃
Quiet afternoon. Who wants to read the Alimbekov Library exhibition notice? 12 manuscript facsimiles, free, from Monday
Taking the kids Tuesday if it's free 📚
Yes, free. Bring the older ones, the facsimiles are big and they like the pictures
[sticker: bilbeim]
Nurzhan air is 196 now, Talas 106. Cold inversion over the basin again
Heat plant gas switch still unfunded, that's what the Herald says. Shame
Unfunded means nobody is going to pay. Nurzhan lives with the smog until spring
Please keep kids in at break in Nurzhan. Cough syrup at the pharmacy is fine, no need to panic
[sticker: salam]
Sheep thieves got caught, Korgoncho. Two men, 11 sheep taken, nine back. Nine is better than none
Nine back, good. Two sheep gone is still a loss for a family. Hope they had a good reason to lie about it
Ugh 😞 I hope the owner got the nine home safe
Toktogul 83% full and dropping. Power is normal in all three cities though, so someone is managing it
Exports to Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan on the contract schedule, so no cuts for us
Good, I can keep my heater on tonight 🔥
Who is going to the Hippodrome for the Irad Cup final? That's the 7th, not today
Me. Neftchi Nurzhan vs Attelkom, it's the Irad Cup final. Could be a good one
Who is going to win?
Neftchi. They are the champions, and they won the league by one point
Attelkom will make it hard though. They beat Kara-Buura 2-0 last round, don't forget
Kids want to come too 😅 Is it a family match?
Families yes, the stands near the gate are fine
Pass the thermos, I'm freezing at the window 🍵
Sticker of the day coming up: [sticker: chai]
Anyone at the Tündük tonight? Want to try the chai before Thursday
We're here after 19:00, the window table
Salam. Does the Fergana Gateway need chains now? Driver said yes past Ala-Bel
Chains or winter tyres required, yes. Suusamyr is closed for the winter anyway, don't try it
I sell winter tyres on the Trans-Talas road 😄 Come before the snow
Marat advertising in the chat again 😂
Only when someone asks. Nurbek asked
Diesel in the Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75 now, Gulzada's cousin told me. Brutal
Brutal indeed. Petrol 95 in town is 5.85 at least 😅
[sticker: tlpr_down]
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar 22 som a kilo. My uncle says the crop was small. Shopping list for the weekend
Small crop, yes. Apples in Chu 3.45 so the fruit is cheap up there at least
Ulak in Kara-Bulak this week? Kids want to watch. Dastgoh vs Kara-Bulak on Saturday, Dastgoh won 5-2
Kara-Bulak lost 5-2 to Dastgoh, yes. Ulak not football, that's the Highland thing, different
Right right, ulak. My horses prefer it anyway 🐎
Anyone else cold? Radiator in the new flat is ice. Going to borrow an electric heater
Ask the agent, he's honest-ish. Heating season is on, he should fix it
Begaiym you're my hero 😂
Kids asleep. Sunday evening is my only quiet hour 🌙
Tulpar women's last round, Attelkom 3-0 Neftchi, Universitet 3-2 Iyık Janyl. Tulpar drew 2-2 with Akademiya
Tulpar still top of the women's table. 23 points, nobody can catch them now
Good season for them 💜
Mask for the bazar tomorrow, Bakyt said. I will obey
Good girl. Air is bad in the lower bazar, I can smell it from here
[sticker: horse_love]
Night all. Tomorrow the lost dog story again, I hope nobody's dog runs off 😅
Night Nurbek. Bars is home, he's asleep on the radiator 🐶
Night everyone. Dress warm 🧣
Night. Monday early shift, the 14 better be on time
Night Talas. Cash count at 6 again 💵
Night. Hippodrome Saturday 12 Dec for the play-offs if anyone wants tickets 🏇
Night. Horses are asleep, good 🐴
Still awake. Cold room, warm blanket 🥶
Up before the sun again. Frost on the potato rows, minus 5 in the yard
Kayırluu tañ! Talas is grey and cloudy, high 7 today. Dress warm 🧣
Kayırluu tañ. Early shift again. The 14 better show up this time
Air is bad too, my eyes sting already
Talas AQI 139 on the app, unhealthy for sensitive people. Mask on my way to the booth
Nurzhan is 159 today, I checked my cousin's group. Glad I moved, but my lungs are not happy about the visit 😅
Three kids, three masks, one bag of wet socks 😩
Tyre shop opens at 8. Winter tyres, chains, tyres, chains. Everyone wants both this week 🚗
Chains for the Fergana road? Ala-Bel is open but they say chains or winter tyres required. Don't go without
Bakyt is right. Winter tyres are cheaper than a ditch
Quick question: the Talas housing article in the Herald. Up in the Microdistricts or out to the fields? My vote is up, less mud
Up. The fields are fine for potatoes, not for a flat with three kids 😂
Out to the fields, obviously. I have the fields 🥔
Rent up in Talas is 1,000 to 1,500 a month for one room. Nurzhan is 750 to 1,200, so I'm not complaining
Rustam you're in the cheap place now, enjoy 😂
The 14 came. 15 min late, but it came. Marshrutka behind it was 10 min early, which is worse 🙄
That's the Talas bus system in one line
Anyone at Bazar-i Kalan today? Changers say dollar 11.50 buy, 12 sell
Yes 11.50 / 12.00 for USD, euro 12.50 / 13.10. Official is 8.40 so they're doing fine 😏
Someone's cousin is going to Almaty in spring. Ruble 13.25 buy, 14.45 sell, that's just robbery for a trip
Changers don't rob, they just know the market 😂
Hay for the horses now 26 som a bale in the valleys. Two horses eat like a family of six
Hay is the real money. Potatoes are 2.10 a kilo now and I am not getting rich on them either
Horse people always complaining, we are the true farmers 🐴
Teller shift done for the morning. Half the branch wanted to exchange coins for notes. Coins are not money, apparently
Coins are money. Just heavy money 😅
Lunch: plov from the cafe near the kindergarten. 28 som a plate, portion is small but the carrots are good
Nan from the stall by the North Terminal, 3.50 a loaf, still warm. Best thing about Talas so far 🥖
Who's coming Thursday 18:30? Tündük café or the teahouse by philology, I forget which we booked
Teahouse behind philology. I'll bring boorsok this time, promise
Ooba! Then it's settled 💜
Tulpar women's table: Tulpar 23, Universitet 22, Attelkom 16. Last round is over, so they're champions? No, wait, that's the league. Confused
Tulpar are top of the women's league after round 10. Season finished. Good job girls
Taxi from Liberty to the Hippodrome, 15 som starting. The driver wanted 20 because of the air. Bad air, bad price
Hippodrome stables smell fine, I checked. Come see the horses and forget the air
Timur, is it true the play-offs are at the Hippodrome on 12 December?
Yes, Saturday 12 Dec, 19:00 and 21:00. Semi-finals. Final is 19 Dec, same ground
Tulpar are not in the semis unless they finish top two in the Highland thing, no wait, that's ulak. Ignore me 😅
Timur, the Highland thing is ulak. Play-offs with Chu and the Highland place 2 for the ulak. Stop 🤣
I am so confused by this room today 😂
Diesel 6.10 at the Talas station this morning. Petrol 95 5.85. Still cheaper than the Chatkal villages at 8.55 and up, I hear
Don't say numbers at me, I am counting my petrol money 😩
Nurzhan's air is worse, 196 yesterday they say. Heat plant gas switch still not funded. Herald had it
Yes saw it. Source count, a gas date, and a refuse figure. Nobody answers. Typical
Bet the refuse figure is in a drawer somewhere 😂
Lots of people at the branch asking about the Fergana road. Yes, chains needed. No, I don't know if they're open at night
Night is the cold part. Minus 5 at night here, the ice is fine, the drivers are not
Heard about the 2.4 kg heroin seized on State Route 1 in Iyık Janyl? Two men held. Terrible news
Route 1 at night is always trouble. Hope the police got the whole network
Our kids cannot know about this. Just say it was a bad day on the road 😔
Anyone seen the Alimbekov Library free exhibition? 12 manuscript facsimiles, opens Monday, so today maybe
I'm going on Thursday with my students. Facsimiles are nicer than the originals behind glass, honestly
Evening. Tomorrow I drive to the mill with the potatoes. Pray for the road
Bakyt, take the chains. The pass is not the mill road but the ice is everywhere
Anyone know a good heater shop? Electric one I borrowed is making a smell
Don't use it on the wall socket. Ask Timur, he knows about electric things 😂
I'm a teller, not an electrician. Shop near the Communications Square, the guy with the blue shutter. Ask for Ulan
Rahmat! Going tomorrow. Shop is open till 8?
Sister's car went on the ice this morning. Nothing broken, just scared. Chains on Monday, I promise myself
Bars is back from the dog park, cold feet and happy 🐶
Tomorrow the Irad Cup final is not till Saturday. Neftchi Nurzhan 2-0 Attelkom in the Cup? That was the 7 Nov game. Old news now
Elnur, the Cup final was 7 Nov, Neftchi won 2-0. Keep up 😄
Right, I'm still tired from the early shift. Neftchi won the title in the league too, we all know it
Neftchi on 63, Tulpar on 62. One point gap, zero rounds left. Season is done, the table is final 🏆
Good season for the Nurzhan lot. Still, Tulpar fans will keep singing 🎶
Students in scarves again, outside the court today. Adjourned to November, we know that already
Adjourned adjourned. Nobody tells us the day
Sunday evening was my quiet hour, Monday is loud. Good night soon 🌙
Aizada, is the chai from Tündük as good as the teahouse one?
Tündük is for the rich. Teahouse for the students. Thursday, you'll see 😂
Ulak in Kara-Bulak result is not in the channel yet. Dastgoh vs Kara-Bulak was 5-2, that's the ISEZ round 11 thing, Sat 21 Nov
Kids asked again about ulak. Kara-Bulak plays Dastgoh ulak on the 28th? No. Ask Jarysh
Dastgoh 5-2 Kara-Bulak is ulak, round 11, Saturday. Kara-Bulak is in the ISEZ table on 12 pts, 8th. Not a football score
Right, Elnur. Ulak, not football. The kids are confused and so am I 🐴
Night approaching. Snow in Kyzyl-Adyr tonight, rain and snow, they say. Brr
Cash count at 6 again, I'm tired already. Night Talas 💵
Night. Remember the Hippodrome tickets for 12 Dec, Tulpar fans, don't wait too long
Night all. Bars is on the radiator, I am on the sofa 🐶
Night. Heater is off, blanket is on 😅
Night. Check your chains tomorrow, people 🚗
Night. Early shift, 14 bus, pray for me 🙏
Night. Horses are asleep. Hay is on the list for tomorrow 🐴
Night everyone. Thursday teahouse, don't forget. Dress warm 🧣

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Кто-нибудь знает, Нефтчи в субботу на Чу-плаце играет или это не у нас?
Игорь, ты спишь? Ты же у нас в курсе всего 😄
Доброе утро! Дома +4, батареи тёплые только на кухне 🙄
Доброе. На смене ночью было -5 у проходной. Туман стоит, дышать тяжело
Нуржан сегодня AQI 160, опять inversion. Пожилых родителей не выпускаю, дети в школе в масках 😩
Маски в школе это уже норма? Когда я училась, такого не было
В Политехе датчики на крыше показывали 68.9 PM2.5 вчера вечером. Окна в лаборатории не открываем вообще
Morning! Is the air always like this? In Talas it was not so bad yesterday
Айгерим, доброе! В Таласе обычно лучше, у нас котельные и НПЗ рядом 🙂 Главное окна закрывать
Ветер с востока — тогда и на Дастгохе хуже. Сегодня, похоже, с востока 😄
Ha ha, I'll remember! Rahmat 🙏
Ребят, на Чу-плац в 16:00 сегодня? Или в субботу ещё в 16:00? Путаюсь уже
Kostya, сегодня суббота, Чу-плац в 16:00, это ты не перепутал. Плац Нуржан – Ак-Суу, Dastgoh не при чём 😅
Ну вот видите, я же говорил 😂
Кто идёт на Чу-плац? Я Дамира беру, он третий раз в этом сезоне
Я после смены в 15:00 приду, если успею. Андрей на Нефтчи 🙂
Я приду с флагом, если кто ещё забыл 🙂
Печенье уже испекла, но у меня одна духовка и она барахлит 🙈
Oy, I can bring bread from the bazaar, nan 3.50 som loaf, fresh one at the corner 🙂
Айгерим, хлеб тоже хорошо. Чай у тебя на Дастгохе в какое время?
After the match, around 17:30? Aibek, will your boys be on the pitch?
Да, в 17:00 у нас игра на площадке, потом заходите 👍
Кто видел, Нефтчи вчера в таблице, Тулпар 62 — Талас тоже в тридцатке? 😂 Шучу. Ну, Тулпар 62
Тулпар 62, мы 63. Чемпионы уже, но отдыхать не будем, Кубок 7 ноября! 🏆
Кубок 7 ноября это 2:0 с Аттелкомом по-моему? Кто же помнит 🙂
Мальчики, финал Кубка ещё не сыгран, вы его уже выиграли 😅 Ждём 7-го
Наши с Дастгоха говорят, вода опять до 14:00 не будет. Кто знает, что с трубами?
У нас тоже бывает. Набирайте заранее, как я говорила 😉
Оксана, если по громкоговорителю не объявили, это точно плановый ремонт. Звоните в ЖЭК, не в газету
Звонила. Там сказали «в течение дня». Ну, понятно 🙄
Сургут: кто-то уже оформил перевод через Талас-банк? Комиссия 1–2%, я думаю всё-таки через Казахстан 🤔
Через Казахстан не лучше, везде свои нюансы. Главное не везти много наличных
Шурин говорил, курс в Базаре сегодня 11.95 продажа доллара. Дорого 😩
Kostya, не продавай то, что нужно детям 😄 Лучше купи им ботинки, они растут 🥾
Sorry, a silly question: a bale of hay in the valleys is 26 som? My cousin keeps horses in Talas. Is it a lot?
Для Таласа тюк сена за 26 — нормально, в долинах так и есть. Зимой цена растёт, это точно
Ok good. My cousin says it is more in the city 🙂
Аи, на Чу-плаце ветер, дети замёрзли, чай уже хочется 🫖
Оксана, идите к Айгерим, там тепло, у неё окна закрыты 😄
Yes come! I have hot tea and Dilnoza's cookies 🙂
Кто смотрит расписание Таласа на вторник? Ульак Тартыш Кара-Булак в ISEZ, говорят в 19:00 на ипподроме
Это ИСЕЗ, Игорь, ульак. Кара-Булак в 17-м ряду 🙂 Не там ищешь
Ага, точно. Ульак, не футбол. Спасибо, Костя
Тулпар Талас проиграл? Гоню за Тулпаром 😄
Андрей, не о тех речь. Сегодня у нас Нуржан в ИСЕЗ играет с Семизом в 16:00 на Чу-плаце, ты не с нами?
Мы на Чу-плаце в 16:00 не успели. Простите 😅 Завтра на вахте
Айгерим, спасибо за чай. Печенье Дилнозы тоже супер 🍪
Ну, спасибо. Духовка всё-таки пережила день 😄
Дастгох против Кара-Булака завтра в 16:00 на нашем ground, приходите болеть
Айбек, ты уже тренер? 😄 Приду, если дети не устроят бунт
Говорят, у Политеха нет ответа по газу для котельных, Совет так и не опубликовал тариф. Опять 🙃
Игорь, ты уже не спишь? 😂 Лучше смотри в свою лабораторию и монеты
Good night! Tomorrow I go to the refinery in the morning 🙂
Айгерим, удачи на первой смене! Не забудь шарф 🧣
Кто на Сургут в ноябре всё-таки едет? Перевод через Талас-банк 2.5% в прошлый раз, это много
Андрей, пиши в личку, тут же не банк 😄
Топите, но окна держите закрытыми 🙂 Всем спокойной ночи
Спокойной ночи! Завтра утром опять туман, наверное
Спокойной ночи, Нуржан 🌙
[sticker: kalpak]
Не сплю, на смене отчёт по котельной 😩
Костя, ты в ночь? Иди спать, котельная без тебя не остынет
Доброе утро, Нуржан! Дома +14, на улице туман как молоко 🌫️
У нас на Дастгохе воды опять нет до 13:00, объявили по громкоговорителю
Опять 😤 Опять набирайте в ванну
Мы уже набрали, Оксана 😄
Доброе. Я с ночной сдал смену, спать как убитый. Воздух сегодня как резина, в горле жжёт
Андрей, ты уже видел? Herald пишет AQI 234 на Нуржане. Дети в садик в масках пойдут 😷

Evening. Talas air in the news again, 139. Nurzhan worse. My sister said the kids can't play outside
Cousin in Nurzhan says the smoke is in the bedroom again. Stay home if you can. Sorry for repeating
[sticker: bilbeim]
Sheep in the shed, cat on the stove where it belongs 🐱
[sticker: kosh]
Tomorrow: Highland ulak round 12 is Saturday, not tomorrow. Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00 on the winter grounds
Moiynkum road, chains again. I'll drive, I won't watch
Boztorgoy 30 points, top of the highland table. They won't lose easy
Kubat, your dogs are sitting again. Tell them the ulak is on Saturday
They already know. Dogs don't need a calendar 😄
Who is going to the Nurzhan side with potatoes next week? Ask price there, not Talas prices
Ask Kubat. He sells to whoever pays on time, and Nurzhan pays late
Bring cash. Nothing else works in Nurzhan
Tomorrow is the first real school day of the week. Kids, bags, bed at 21:00 like a grown-up 😴
Gn valleys. Power fine, the extra megawatts go to export, not to your street
Ha. Gn Sapar. Kudai saktasın
Gn all. Hay on the truck, chains in the cab, road holds
Gn. Chains, Mairam. Don't forget them
Gn. Potatoes are fine. Kubat said so
Gn all. The dogs are asleep, the potatoes are asleep 🌙
Gn. Kudai saktasın hammeege 🌙

horses.t: Morning. Frost on the Hippodrome gate this morning, my tea froze in the thermos lid 🥶
Frost is nothing. Wait till the Otmek wind. Dress warm for the stands tonight
Tonight is ulak in Talas! 19:00 at the Hippodrome, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 🐎 wear the big kalpak
Kyzyl-Adyr will bring the young ones, I heard. Talas still has the old riders, so cheer for them 😄
Poll: who scores first tonight?
Chabysh was good yesterday! Two horses fine, colt happy in the truck. Rahmat Rysbek for the road 🙏
Glad it went well. Ice near the bridge was real though, slow down on the valley road
Nurzhan air today is bad, AQI 160 on the screen. Keep the old horses out of the smog if you can
Yes, keep them indoors if you can, and water them well. Dust in the lungs is no joke
Hay update: I found 40 bales from a farm near Kara-Buura. Still need 20 more. Anyone?
Valley hay is 26 a bale now. Chu side was 22 last week, if you bring a truck
Same story every year. Buy early, pay later 😩
Round 10 check: Lower Naryn 7–6 Kara-Bulak, that was a crazy game. Kyzyl-Adyr 4–2 over Köhne Diz 😄
Talas 2–3 Dastgoh, we lost that one. Chu 6–3 Sary-Bulak. Iyık Janyl 5–4 Nurzhan again ugh
Iyık Janyl are on fire. 16 points now, same as Dastgoh
Who is playing today? I can't keep up
Nurzhan v Semiz at 16:00 on the Chu plain, Dastgoh v Kara-Bulak at 16:00 at their works ground. Both done soon?
Round 11 is today! Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00, Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak 21:00 at the Hippodrome. Long night
Wear something warm, the stands get cold after 21:00 🥶
Ulak is on! Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr, first half is full stands already 🐎
Kyzyl-Adyr should have brought better kalpaks lol 😂
Köhne Diz still on zero from the early games? Oh wait, they had 7 points. Tonight is their game, they need it
Final results will be posted by the Directorate. Good night all, check your foals first 🌙
Good ulak night. Thermos is empty, going home. Night all 🐎
Night! Kyz kuu practice tomorrow in the yard, the groom is still scared 😂
Who was up for the Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr result? Aidana, did Talas win in the end? 😴
Morning horse people. Frost on the windscreen, the mares are fine though
Mares fine, Marat? Mine are blanketed since last night, dont tell me it wasnt needed
😄 you are always the careful one
Talas 10–6 over Kyzyl-Adyr!! The old riders showed up 🔥
Finally I can sleep. Kyzyl-Adyr brought the kalpaks at least
Boztorgoy are a machine. 30 pts and they still look hungry
Karakoyun v Naiman not received yet, so nobody knows. Directorate is slow again
Sheets go in by noon usually. Be patient
Nurzhan air this morning is awful. Bad on my chest just walking to the stables
Same, the colt has been coughing a bit. I keep him in the stable with the window shut
Keep him in, wet hay is worse with the smog. Check his breathing twice a day. If it doesnt settle call me at the centre
Rahmat doctor 🙏 I will watch him tonight
Still looking for 20 bales. Valley hay is 26 a bale, cant argue with that, the price is the price
Chu side maybe 22 if you bring your own truck. Still early, the snow will push it up
Buy early, pay later as always 😩
Ice on the valley road again this morning. Anyone going to Nurzhan today?
Not me, Nurzhan air is 234 on the screen. Staying in Talas with the window closed
Talas AQI 100, moderate. Honestly Talas is easy to breathe this week
Kyz kuu practice in the yard at 11. The groom is back, he brought a helmet this time 😂
Smart groom. Ask him to keep the helmet on for the whip part too
Temir! I will be gentle, promise 😄
[sticker: horse_love]
Anyone watching the Irad Cup final? Neftchi v Attelkom on the 7th. Who do you think?
Neftchi, they won the league already. Attelkom had a good last round but 2-0 for Neftchi is my guess
Tulpar fans are upset Neftchi got the title by 1 point 😂 Tulpar had 62 and Neftchi 63
A point is a point. Neftchi beat Tulpar 2–1 in the last round, that was the day
Lunch break. Plov at the bazar is 28 a plate, I still buy it every day
Plov at 28 and the tea is free, not bad
Colt is breathing easier after lunch. Still watching him
Good. Dont let him roll in the wet straw. Dry bedding only
Trans-Talas road, a tyre shop day. Three trucks with bald tyres already this afternoon, no surprise with the ice
Winter tyres on before the Otmek wind, Marat. Your own shop should know that 😄
Ha, the shoemaker has no shoes 🐎
Remember the sheep taken from Korgoncho pen? Two held, nine sheep found. Cheap sheep are still expensive
Sheep and horses, the thieves never get tired
Toktogul is 82 percent full and still drawing down. Grandma is worried about the power, she always is
Power is normal in all three cities, dont worry grandma 😄
Tonight nothing at the Hippodrome, right? Next ulak is the 28th? Highland round 12 is Saturday
Highland round 12 is the 28th: Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00 at the winter grounds. Sets it up
Boztorgoy will smash Moiynkum. Akjele v Karakoyun at Upper Besh-Tash is the one I care about
Chubar v Kökjal at Arslanbob, 15:00. I'll drive out, the road is clear
[sticker: kalpak]
Anyone going to the play-off semis on 12 Dec? Chu v the Highland place 2 at 19:00
Yes I have tickets. Stands get cold after 21:00, bring a thermos
Talas plays the second semi at 21:00 vs Highland place 1. Kyz kuu demo at halftime, I asked the Hippodrome already
Demo? Aidana you will fall off in front of the whole city 😂
Only if the groom holds the horse 😄
Colt temperature normal now. Good sign Gulsara
Rahmat Azim! Feeling better already 🙏
Irad Cup final 7 Nov is done already, so Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. Congrats to Neftchi
Askat that's the 7th of November, it is the 22nd now. Did you mean the Irad Cup final on the 7th, we already had that
Yes yes, I mixed my dates. Old man memory 😩
Good night all. Snow on the Otmek ridge tonight, the Hippodrome stables are warm though 🐎
Night horse people 🌙
Night! Practice tomorrow, the groom is still scared 😂
Morning horse people. Frost on the Hippodrome paddock, my two are not happy about it
Chongtor horses wear frost like a kalpak 😄
Your horses are made of stone, we know
Tanıp lost another one. Temir you were right about the old riders
I am always right, ask my wife 😂
Akjele 7–7 with Chatkal Highlands. Nobody wins that one
Colt is eating well this morning. Took him out for ten minutes in the yard, he kicked up snow 😍
Good. Keep the blanket on until the snow melts. Call me if he goes off his feed
Rahmat Azim, you are the best 🙏
Farrier from gate 2 came out to my Chongtor. Old man with the grey beard, you were right Azim
Told you. He does not talk much but his shoes last
Anyone got hay left from the Chu side? Mine is almost gone and the valley price is 26 a bale now
Still 26 in the valleys. I already paid for mine, cheaper than the Hippodrome stables at least
Kara-Bulak station still has lucerne if you can wait for delivery
Heard Iyık Janyl had 2.4 kg of heroin on State Route 1. Two men held. Horrible news for a Sunday
Those roads at night, the trucks never stop. Drivers should be careful
Sheep and heroin, the Iyık Janyl road has everything 😩
Lunch then practice. Groom says he will hold the horse only if I promise no whip 😂
Promise nothing, Aidana
Nurzhan air is bad today, AQI 159 on the sheet. Keep the horses in the covered stalls, no long trots
Right. Coughing horses from the smog are coming in to the clinic. Talas is only 139 but still keep them in
Our Akyel air is clean, the mountains do their job 😌
Akyel is also a long way from Nurzhan, that's all
Highland round 12 is Saturday the 28th. Boztorgoy v Moiynkum 13:00, Akjele v Karakoyun at Upper Besh-Tash 14:00. Who's going to Besh-Tash?
I will be at the Hippodrome that morning for practice. Maybe I can make it for the Akjele one
Karakoyun will win. Akjele have no answer to their second row
Karakoyun have only played 9 games, Temir. Let them have one bad day
Grandma says the Toktogul water is still going down. 81.8 percent, she checked the news again
Grandma should come to the Hippodrome, we have warmer stables than the lake
Power is still normal in Talas, no cuts on the schedule. Good for the stables, the heaters run all night
Snow on the Otmek road already. Going to Kara-Buura on Sunday? Chabysh cancelled if it snows
We go by the old road if it stays dry. Two young horses need the run
Take the blankets. And water them before the ride, don't let them drink cold from the trough
Play-off semi 12 Dec at the Hippodrome: Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00, then Highland place 1 v Talas at 21:00. Marat your tickets are ready?
Ready. Thermos is ready too
Kyz kuu demo at halftime if they let me. The groom says he is still scared
Aidana will fall off in front of the whole city. I will bring a camera 📸
Who is going to the Irad Cup final on the 7th? Neftchi v Attelkom 2-0 was the result, I heard it was a good game
The Cup final was on the 7th of November, it's over. Neftchi won 2–0, Dilbar. We're on the 23rd now
Oh yes, I'm too tired. Sorry
Colt temperature normal, eating, moving about. Good work Gulsara
Rahmat Azim 🙏 Going to sleep happy
Night all. Snow on the Otmek ridge again, the stables are warm 🐎
Night horse people 🌙
Night! Practice Saturday, pray for me 😂

football.t: Morning. Frost on the potatoes already, -6 at the field. Hope the Hippodrome pitch is not a skating rink tonight 😅
Talas pitch is fine, it's the stand that freezes. Bring the blanket Bakyt
Who's going to the Chu game in Nurzhan at 16:00? Dastgoh vs Kara-Bulak is the same time, can't do both 😩
Ulak is for the people who like to suffer. Chu v Semiz is the one I'd watch, they are 26 pts for a reason
Refinery shift done, just got home. Nurzhan smog is thick this morning, can't see the chimney from my kitchen 😷
Мама сказала не ходить на улицу без маски. AQI 160 у нас, это ужас
Yeah it's 160 in Nurzhan. Talas is 90, go visit the valley if you want air 😂
Cup final is on the 7th and Neftchi beat Attelkom 2–0. Still feels weird to say it out loud
Attelkom played well for an hour. Then the sun came out at the wrong moment for them 😂
Attelkom are not a cup team, they are a cup-final team. Different things 😤
Women's League wrap: we finished 1st on 23, Universitet 2nd on 22. Our last round was 2–2 with Akademiya, I'm still annoyed
Tulpar women top of the table, Nazgul you should be happy 🤍
I am happy. I'm also annoyed. Both is fine 😄
[sticker: jailoo]
Ermek that is a picture of a yurt in the snow, nobody is going to the jailoo in November
I am going to the jailoo in my dreams. Hay is 26 som a bale in the valleys now, I bought 10 for my cow, I'm broke 😭
Hay at 26 and you still come to the match 🤣 respect
Derby is over, that's it. Neftchi champions, I can say it now. 2026 🖤🧡
You won by one point, Andrei. Don't make a speech about it
63 to 62 is a speech 😎
Нефтяник чемпион! Папа сказал, что будет праздник на НурГаз 🖤🧡
Temirjolchu finished 7th on 31, that's a good season for a club with a budget of a raffle 👏
Serious question: what's the point of the Talas Herald writing about the Chatkal leopards when we can't even get a stadium toilet 😂
Cameras found three snow leopards and no compensation for the herders. That's the real story, Azat
Yeah fair. Herders get nothing and we get a 5-som kiosk coffee 😅
Hippodrome tonight 19:00 vs Kyzyl-Adyr. Anyone coming from town? Walk from the centre, no bus needed 😂
Nazgul is walking this time, I checked. Marshrutka is 30 but I'm not paying for nothing again
Walnuts for the stand, Bakyt's Toktogul ones at 22 som a kilo. I'm buying two bags 🌰
Two bags is a lot Ermek, the stand will smell like a bakery 😄
Chu v Semiz result is in the ulak sheet? Not yet for me, it's still on the pitch 🐎
[sticker: haha]
Кто-нибудь знает, есть ли билеты на финал Кубка? Хочу на 7 ноября... ой, это уже прошло 🙈
Final was on the 7th, Vika. You're a bit late for that one. Next year's calendar comes from the club office
Понятно. Спасибо, Андрей 🖤
Two hours to kick-off on the Hippodrome. Who is in the stand, you lot? 🤍
Jolbors in the stand with the walnuts 🐆🌰
Me too. Kyzyl-Adyr are 13 pts, we are not scared of 13 🐎
Pablo, Kyzyl-Adyr have a 7-goal game in them somewhere, careful 😂
Cold tonight, Talas 5 high, -6 low. Bring the thermos, not the beer 🍵
Game at 19:00 is the Talas one, the kick-off is listed as in the Hippodrome. Ah. Not football, this is ulak 😂
Ulak Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr, the Hippodrome. Football is Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak at 21:00 same place. Two games at the same ground tonight 🐎
Football fans, shut it, we are the only ones with a proper sport tonight 😂
Ulak 19:00 started, I can hear the horses from my flat. Talas will not lose on a Saturday 🤍
Night game lads, the air is bad in Nurzhan so Talas is breathing better 😂
Lower Naryn 7–6 Kara-Bulak last week btw, who watches these games, I'm not even sure they're real 😂
Real enough. I've got a bag of walnuts and a team to support, that's real
Sunday I'm not doing anything. Football on Monday? Who knows. Let me sleep first 😴
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Night shift tomorrow, no derby this week. Good night from Nurzhan 🖤🧡
Спокойной ночи всем 🧣
Night. Walnuts gone, Bakyt owes me 2 kilos 😂
Write it down Ermek, the walnuts are in the stand, not in my bag 🌰
Night. Deportivo Semiz 3rd in First League, don't forget 😤
Still up. Who has the ulak sheet for the Hippodrome tonight? Lower Naryn stuff is on the sheet, Semiz not yet 🐎
Morning Jolbors. Did the walnuts survive the night or is Bakyt still in debt 😂
Bakyt paid 1 kilo, says the other is a 'stand tax' 🌰
Fake news. It was a loan. Cold on the pitch in Talas this morning, the potato rows were white
Sunday off. Coffee, then the table. We are 1 point behind Neftchi and the season is over, that's a sad sentence 😔
63 to 62. You had your chance 😎 Congrats on the 2nd place though, nobody expected it in March
Talas air 100 today, moderate. Nurzhan is 234. Andrei, how do you breathe in that city 🙄
With the window shut and a bad mask. Heat plant gas switch still not funded, so it's the same story every morning
Herald says the air needs a source count. Who would count, the same people who fund the gas?
Андрей, сколько стоит билет на выездной матч в Талас? Хочу посмотреть на Тулпар вживую 🧣
Vika, the away section is only through the club and only with ID. Ask at the office, don't buy from the guy outside 😅
Cup final was Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom, so nobody here needs to say anything about cups today 😂
Not the cup, the women's league. Tulpar women top with 23, Universitet 22. Nazgul told us already
Yes Azat, and I'm saying it again. 2–2 with Akademiya last round, but still top 🤍
[poll: Ulak Talas vs Kyzyl-Adyr 2 weeks back, who was better on the pitch?]
Honest answer: the horses. Ulak is the real sport 🐎
Pablo, every week you say that and every week I have to answer 😂
Hay is 26 a bale in the valleys now. Last year it was 19. My horses don't read the table, they just eat 🐆
Tell me about it. Potatoes at 2.10 a kilo at the gate and nobody wants them. Winter is going to be long 🥔
Night shift from tonight. Derby for next season already on the calendar? Club office says spring
Spring is ages. I'll be at the Hippodrome for the play-off final on 19 Dec, that's the real calendar for me
Play-offs: Chu v Highland place 2 on 12 Dec, Highland place 1 v Talas 21:00. Talas in the ulak play-offs, not the football, lol
Semiz is 2 points in the ISEZ, nobody says the word Semiz 😤
Pablo, you say it every day. Maybe that's why people don't
Спасибо Андрей за ответ, я спрошу в офисе клуба 🖤
Good, Vika. And wear the warm jacket, the east stand is cold even in the day 🧥
Who is coming to Kara-Buura on the 28th? Pass is closed for the winter, the old road too. Have to go through Kara-Buura pass by the high road? No, wait, that's closed too 😅
Sasha, the Kara-Buura Pass is closed for winter. Football goes by the Fergana Gateway with chains, or you stay home 😄
Round 12 is Saturday. Nobody needs a pass to see the table, we all know it
Sunset at 17:20 and the valley already smells of coal. Heating is on, the smog is on 😷
Tulparcoin is 3.40 cents today, up 3.5%. Someone tell Bakyt to buy 🪙
I'd rather buy a sack of potatoes. At least I know what they weigh 😂
Ulak Talas will be in the Hippodrome on Saturday again I guess? Tickets for Dec 12 already on sale? 🐎
Ask the office, I don't do tickets for the ulak. Good luck to Talas, really 🖤🧡
Evening all. Round 11 ulak: Dastgoh 5–2 Kara-Bulak, Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz. Pablo's going to have something to say 😅
Yes I have something to say: Semiz is in the sheet, not in the table 😤
Pablo calm down, Semiz is 11 games in and it's 2 points, nobody's surprised 😂
А кто выиграл у Кара-Булака? 🤔
Dastgoh 5–2, Vika. Kara-Bulak are at 12 pts, they stayed in the mix 😄
Herald piece on the sheep: two held over 11 taken from Korgoncho, nine back. Bakyt, is that your pen?
Not mine, I have 4 ha of potatoes and zero sheep. Good luck to the Korgoncho lot
Toktogul is 82.1% full and drawing down. Power normal in all three cities. Something good for once 🙏
Normal power in Nurzhan too. I'll take that. The air is the other thing
Bought walnuts at Toktogul bazar, 22 a kilo, the price is still not a joke 🌰
Bring me a bag next time Ermek, I'll pay this time 🐎
Deal. Pablo pays, Bakyt owes, the stand gets the walnuts 😂
I'm not in this one, I'm a potato man 🥔
Night game for the Hippodrome on 12 Dec, cold but worth it. Sunday tomorrow, get some sleep lads 🤍
Night shift tomorrow. Good night Talas, good night Semiz. Pablo calm down 🖤🧡
Night Andrei. Deportivo Semiz, 3rd in First League. Don't forget 😤
Спокойной ночи всем 🧣
Night. Tulpar women top, Talas breathing, Nurzhan not so much 🤍
Night. Court on the coin is on the 16th, I hope the students in the scarves are there too 😂
Both sides of the scarf, Azamat 😄 Good night
Night. Potatoes are still in the ground, I'm going to sleep like one 🥔
Night all. Round 12 Saturday, Boztorgoy v Moiynkum 13:00 in the winter grounds. Jolbors goes, walnuts in the bag 🐆
Night. Table is done, season is done, the spring is far. Sleep well 😴
Morning. Cold in Talas, -5 at night, the bus stop was a fridge 🥶
Night shift done. Nurzhan is 9 degrees high and the air is still bad, I could taste it on the bus
Season is over, champions are Neftchi, nothing to play for but the cup final on the 7th 😴
Cup final is still a final 😎 Attelkom had their chance on the 7th and you saw what happened
Women's League top was 23 pts. Tulpar women finished above Universitet by one, proud of them
Congrats to the girls 🤍 Universitet won 3–2 at Iyık Janyl in the last round btw, they're not going down quietly
Поздравляю Талас с девочками 🤍 Attelkom 3:0 нам в последнем туре, мы не гордимся
Thanks Vika, honest answer 😄
Lunch. Kara-Buura in 9th on 25 pts, I'll take 9th. Anyone going to the Aksay trip for round 12?
Nobody goes to Aksay Plateau Select on purpose 😂 Boztorgoy 13:00 is more my level
Boztorgoy v Moiynkum in the winter grounds, I already told you the walnuts are coming 🐆
That's the ulak, Ermek. Football fans, stop stealing our saturday 😤
Herald says Talas is debating housing: Microdistricts or fields and foothills. Who would move out to the fields?
Me, I'm already on a field 😄 but a 1-room flat in Talas is 1,000–1,500 som a month, that's a field money-wise too
Microdistricts for me, bus to the bank is 15 min. Fields means chains on the car every winter
Power is normal here, no cuts, heating on. Only the air is a problem. Nurzhan AQI 159 this morning, unhealthy 😷
Мы с мамой в Нуржане, окна не открываем уже неделю 😷
Herald says the heat plant gas switch is still unfunded. Good luck to whoever pays for that 🙃
[poll: Who gets the cup on the 7th? Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom is already done 😂 your guess for the score?]
Cup final is 7 Nov, it's over already, we're not voting on a finished thing
Fine, Neftchi 2–0, I just liked the poll 😅
Semiz had 2.4 kg heroin news from Iyık Janyl on the route. Not us, thank God, but the Route 1 road is busy with trucks
Hope the police get the rest of it, that road is bad enough with the ice
ice on the roads, chains on the pass, nobody's going to Kara-Buura this week
Toktogul reservoir 81.8% now. Walnuts 22 a kilo at the bazar, Ermek you're robbing us
Not me, the bazar 🌰 I only carry them
Ребята, кто на Кызыл-Адыр в субботу? Там же ulak, не футбол
Vika the Kyzyl-Adyr ulak is the one with Kara-Bulak against Dastgoh? no, Dastgoh played Kara-Bulak last round 😂
Dastgoh 5–2 Kara-Bulak, round 11, Vika. You keep asking the same thing 😄
Спасибо, Бакыт 🙈
Round 11: Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz. I'm not bitter. Semiz is 2 points and 10 games played, that's the sheet
Pablo we know, we were there in the chat last night 😅
Night game at the Hippodrome on 12 Dec, Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00, then us at 21:00. Cold, but I'm buying the tickets
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Court on the Liberty name is 16 Nov, nobody's expecting a ruling that day, just an adjournment again 😂
Still better than the Talas bus schedule, which is what I'm worried about this week 🚌
Night shift tomorrow. Derby is done, the table is done. Good night Talas 🖤🧡
Good night Andrei, 62 vs 63 forever 😂
Спокойной ночи 🧣 Завтра в институт
Night all. Round 12 Saturday, Boztorgoy v Moiynkum 13:00, Jolbors goes, bag of walnuts in the pocket 🐆
Deportivo Semiz, 3rd in First League. Still on the list 😤
Night. Potatoes still in the ground, I'm going to sleep like one 🥔
Night. Coin court on the 16th, scarves both sides 🤍❤️
Night. Table done, season done, spring is far. Sleep well 😴

diaspora.t: Yekat at midnight and the snow started. Mum says it's the first real one 🌨️
Korea is 10am tomorrow for me, so I'm already late for everything 😂
Morning from Chicago. Kids are asking if Irad has snow yet. Told them Talas is 5 degrees today, they said that's warm 😅
Novosib is -12 and I'm complaining about 5 😂 Talas is basically the Riviera now
Moscow morning, coffee first. Anyone else going to Talas for Nov holidays? Asking for my sister
Almaty is cloudy and the air is ok today. Not like Nurzhan, my cousin sent a photo of a grey sky there 😷
Did the mask thing on the bus again. Mum says Nurzhan AQI 160 today, unhealthy, keep kids inside
Berlin has no inversion though 😂 just rain
Surgut -18 this morning. Car wouldn't start, had to use the heater for 20 min first 🥶
Anyone know if the Talas Herald has the Toktogul numbers? Dad keeps sending me the reservoir stats, now at 82.4% 😅
Yes 82.4%, 15.66 km³ of 19, drawing down. Dad says hope exports stay on the schedule
Your dad is a better news source than the TV 😄
Lunch: bought Turkish strained yogurt again. Trying Aijan's beet suzma tonight, wish me luck 🫠
Add the garlic slowly!! And dill, not parsley 😭
Korean market had cucumbers 3x the price of home. Not complaining, just noticing 😂
Dad's cousin in Kara-Koyun says hay is 26 som a bale in the valleys. Still cheaper than Berlin's coffee 😂
Surgut petrol 5.40 AI-92 here? No, I'm in Surgut, I just wanted to check Talas prices. Tell me it's still 5.40 🙏
Talas AI-92 is 5.40 per the bazar boards, diesel 6.10. Don't ask me why I know this
Nurzhan 16:00 Dastgoh v Kara-Bulak and Semiz v Nurzhan on the Conference. Who is watching? My brother says Dastgoh will win
Ulak fans in Berlin are a small group but loud 😂 I'll watch the stream later
Watching the Highland game at 13:00 later, Boztorgoy v Tanıp. Boztorgoy 27 pts already, sounds like a long shot for Tanıp
Question: is the Bank of Irad rate still 8.40 for dollars? I want to send some money to Mum before the month ends
Yes 8.40 official. Bazar is 11.55 to buy, 11.95 to sell right now. Mum says just send dollars 😅
Good lord. And the euro is 12.50 at the bazar? 🙈
12.50 buy, 13.10 sell this morning. Rubles 13.25 buy. Moscow changers are not this generous 😂
